flashcard_questions.q: A programme set up by Rio’s authorities in the 1990s to improve living conditions in favelas rather than demolishing them.
A scheme where the local authority provides land and basic services so residents can build or improve their own homes.
The wellbeing of individuals or groups, usually relating to access to basic necessities such as food, education, water and housing.
The _____ Bairro Scheme The Favela Bairro (meaning ‘Favela Neighbourhood’) project was set up by the Rio authorities in the 1990s
_____ The $1 billion budget cannot cover all 1,000 favelas in Rio
